# Copilot instructions

<!-- Issue-first instruction rollout: #2 -->

## Issue-first code changes

Before making a code change, identify a relevant issue in this repository. If none
exists, create one describing the requested outcome, intended approach, and
acceptance criteria before editing code. Follow applicable permissions.

Record meaningful changes in intent on the issue, and reference the issue in the
work and any pull request. If Issues or access prevent finding or creating an
issue, stop and ask instead of changing code.

This policy applies to code changes, not questions or research.
